QuestInfo.name: If I Could Turn Back Time
QuestInfo.0: Will #p2082003# really talk about the accident that happened to #p2082004#? Talk to him to find out.
QuestInfo.1: Will #p2082003# really talk about the accident that happened to #p2082004#? Talk to him to find out.
QuestInfo.2: #p2082004# said hearing about #p2082003# mentioning that sealing of the Black Mage in the past twisted time gives him an idea. Could this be it?

1.0: How does the #t3994444# feel now that it's complete?\r\n#L0##bAmazing. All I had to do was THINK about this place and it brought me.#l\n#k
1.1: Glad it's working out. Did you find out about the seal?\r\n#L0##bI believe the seal of the Black Mage was powerful enough to affect the flow of time.#l\n#k
1.2: What unfathomable magic! Time itself could have been irrevocably twisted.\r\n#L0##bIt's true. It would be impossible to travel to any moment before the Black Mage was imprisoned.#l\n#k
1.3: I see. That's why my calculations were coming up wrong. Who'd have thought such ancient magic would still be in effect today.

yes.0: This is a small reward for all your help. I won't let you refuse. You'll find it useful.
